claim: The one state list is stocklib.registry.BUY_PAGE_STATE_SLUGS (WA/QLD/NSW/VIC/SA). ACT was measured out at 95.8% listing overlap with NSW. Do NOT rank candidate states by our own state-page traffic; that is circular.

body.note: SA is LIVE. The one state list is stocklib.registry.BUY_PAGE_STATE_SLUGS (WA, QLD, NSW, VIC, SA); every builder derives from it, guarded by tests/test_buy_page_states.py. SA launches at the MAX_COMBOS_PER_STATE cap of 20 because no growing guide carries an SA overlay yet; the cap exemption now asks for a state overlay, not has_guide(slug), so SA grows as SA overlays are written.
body.gap: SA gap CLOSED 2026-09-17. Remaining lever for SA is content, not config: 26 more SA combo pages are held back by the cap and each one is unlocked by writing that species' SA overlay in growing_guides/<slug>.json.
body.do_not: Do NOT rank candidate states by our own state-page traffic (WA 469 visitors/30d, NSW 131, VIC 127, QLD 92, SA 0). That is circular: WA leads because we built 75 WA pages. Plausible visit:region returns empty (no geo database configured), so real visitor geography needs DAL-251 first.
body.act_rejected: ACT was in DAL-297's ask and was measured out (DEC-338). ACT's reachable listing set overlaps NSW's by 95.8% (it differs by one nursery, the-heritage-nursery) and 35 of 49 ACT pages would have carried a product list byte-identical to the live NSW page. Do not add ACT without re-measuring that overlap. TAS (3 nurseries) and NT (3) stay excluded as genuinely thin.
